info.title: Stops API
info.description:
Stops of Graubünden with their municipality, operator, modes, system codes and names in five languages. XREF finds a stop by UIC number, abbreviation, name, a Wikidata item or another system's code, or by a translated name.

Consumer API `stops`, contract version 1, declared by the model release Public transport stops of Graubünden 1.0.0. A read takes the live data of a workspace (`workspace`, default: the deployment's default workspace) or one of its publications (`publication`: an ID or `latest`). Every `GET` answers an `ETag` and `304 Not Modified` to a matching `If-None-Match`.

get.description: The shared object of the record with this object ID. The definition's parameters filter it (`404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` when filtered out) and limit its projections.

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: The workspace read (default: the deployment's default workspace); named in `RDM-Workspace`.

parameters.name: publication
parameters.description: Read a publication of the workspace instead of live data: its ID, or `latest` for the current one. Read with the definition of the model release it was published under, which must declare this contract version (`409 PUBLICATION_CONTRACT_MISMATCH`). Named in `RDM-Publication`; a cursor keeps its publication.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: A business date, `YYYY-MM-DD`: keeps the records effective that day by their type's declared effective period (no start after it, no end on or before it). Dated types: Stop; records of other types are not filtered, and a read that can return none of the dated types is `400 AS_OF_NOT_SUPPORTED`. Projection items and ancestors are not dated. The dated types are named in `RDM-As-Of-Applied`.

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: Keeps records below a record whose fields match a value, at any depth. Several values, repeated or comma-separated (a comma inside a value as `%2C`), are alternatives; text matches ignoring case.

parameters.name: municipality
parameters.description: Keeps records below a record whose fields match a value, at any depth. Several values, repeated or comma-separated (a comma inside a value as `%2C`), are alternatives; text matches ignoring case.

parameters.name: operator
parameters.description: Limits `operator` to the items matching a value, and keeps only the records left with one. Several values, repeated or comma-separated (a comma inside a value as `%2C`), are alternatives; text matches ignoring case.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Limits `modes` to the items matching a value, and keeps only the records left with one. Several values, repeated or comma-separated (a comma inside a value as `%2C`), are alternatives; text matches ignoring case.

parameters.name: system
parameters.description: Limits `systemCodes` to the items matching a value, and keeps only the records left with one; on XREF, only those items pass their scores. Several values, repeated or comma-separated (a comma inside a value as `%2C`), are alternatives; text matches ignoring case.

parameters.name: to.system
parameters.description: Crosswalk: show the `systemCodes` items `system` would match, as `target`, in place of the plain parameter's; changes no object, score, order or total. One `to.` name per read. Several values, repeated or comma-separated (a comma inside a value as `%2C`), are alternatives; text matches ignoring case.

get.description: The exposed records the query's terms match, scored by the definition's match rules, best first (score, public type name, name, object ID); with `expect=one`, the single best one. Matching part of a value (contains) needs a term of at least 3 characters; a shorter term matches whole values only. A query whose terms match more than 10,000 records is refused as `400 QUERY_TOO_BROAD`, whatever parameters narrow it. A query holds at most 100 terms. The definition's parameters narrow the scored records without changing their scores.

parameters.name: expect
parameters.description: `one`: the single best record, `404 NO_MATCH` or `409 AMBIGUOUS_MATCH`.

get.description: The changes this API tells its consumers about (`stops-changed`), in position order: `created`, `updated` naming the watched outputs that changed, `deleted`. Start after a position (`after`: `0`, or a publication's `eventSequence`) and continue by `cursor`, a lasting resume token; `caughtUp` says the events derived so far (`headPosition`) are read. With `payload=full` (default) each event carries its object as get by ID answers it with the same parameters, at the feed position `stateAt`; `payload=identity` leaves it out. A parameter filters as on a list, against live data; an event whose object no longer exists passes every parameter but the type. Events are kept as long as the change feed's entries: an older position is `410 EVENTS_EXPIRED`, naming the publication to re-read.

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: The workspace read (default: the deployment's default workspace); named in `RDM-Workspace`.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Keep these events (their keys); several, repeated or comma-separated, are alternatives.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Start after this position: `0`, or a publication's `eventSequence`. Not with `cursor`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `cursor` of a page: continue after it, with the same events and parameters.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: 1–100 with `payload=full` (default 100), 1–1,000 with `payload=identity` (default 500).

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: `full`: each event with its object; `identity`: without it.
